1.title: Martha’s Vineyard Property Once Owned by Jackie Kennedy Onassis Is Now Open to All
1.summary: Visitors to Martha’s Vineyard can now traverse a property once owned by Jackie Kennedy Onassis. Known as the Squibnocket Pond Reservation, the 330-acre reserve opened last year and added a new trail in July.

2.title: Is the Supreme Court’s Shadow Docket Changing?
2.summary: The Supreme Court’s emergency docket has shrunk in recent months, and the way justices issue opinions on these cases has also changed. Our reporter Ann Marimow looks at what these shifts tell us about the justices, and what it could mean for the court.

3.title: Is Trump’s Endorsement of Darline Graham Enough in South Carolina Senate Runoff?
3.summary: The president has made a big bet on a senator’s sister.

4.title: Iran Pledges to Defy Trump’s Economic Sanctions
4.summary: Analysts say Tehran could intensify the dispute militarily after the United States announced new efforts to squeeze Iran’s economy.  One Iranian official vowed that “not a single drop of oil” would leave the gulf.

5.title: Man Who Told of a Childhood With Wolves Dies at 80
5.summary: Marcos Rodríguez Pantoja’s improbable story of a wild youth became the subject of a study, and inspired a novel and film.

6.title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
6.summary: Scott Bessent says the US will sever all economic ties with the country and that any nation partnering with Iran financially will also be isolated.
